title: Secret radiation testing of animals after Pacific nuclear tests

tellings.quote: one of the early documents I found in the Australian archives were was evidence of secret testing of animals for radiation residue from those nuclear experiments

plain: The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart says that early in his digging through the Australian government archives he found documents showing that animals were secretly tested for leftover radiation from the nuclear tests carried out in the Pacific in the 1950s and 60s. He tells it as one of his first finds showing the government doing things in secret.
